summary: ASTROCARE is a proposed smart health monitoring software designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. Space environments can affect cardiovascular health, sleep, physical activity, mental wellness and other physiological functions. Our solution provides a centralized dashboard to collect and visualize relevant health indicators, track changes over time and identify unusual patterns that may require attention. The system aims to help astronauts understand their health status and make informed decisions during missions when immediate communication with Earth may be limited. NASA spaceflight research data will be used to support the scientific foundation of the project. The proposed platform combines data visualization, health trend analysis and an alert mechanism in an accessible software interface. ASTROCARE aims to contribute to safer and more informed human space exploration.
details: 1. Introduction Long-duration space missions create challenges for astronaut health due to microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation and confinement. Continuous awareness of health changes is important for mission safety. 2. Problem Statement Astronauts need an accessible system to monitor different health indicators and understand changes in their physical and behavioral health during space missions. 3. Proposed Solution ASTROCARE is a health monitoring dashboard that organizes astronaut health information and presents it through graphs, indicators and alerts. 4. Main Features - Heart-rate and oxygen saturation data display. - Sleep and physical activity tracking. - Mental wellness self-assessment. - Health trend visualization. - Alerts for unusual readings. - Astronaut health history. 5.
